tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yum bka' 'bring po lha bdun ma'i cho ga'o//

"$ ༄༅// mchog 'dod sems kyi bung ba kun 'chor sa// dngos grub lang tsho'i me tog rnams 'dzum pa'i// rdo rje sems dpa'i rtse dga'i 'khri shing ni// 'khor ba'i tsha gdung skyabs yongs phyag bya'i gnas// rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa nas/ ya mi ni dang skrag byed ma// nags tshal ma dang de bzhin byis// gzugs kun spyod ma mdzes ma dag /bha su ra ga mkha' 'gro bdun// zhes dang*/ gzugs can ma dang tsum bhi ka /lā ma yongs bsgyur byis bcas mo// mi zlog e hi ka lha mo// mkha' 'gro ma rnams bdun du bshad// ces gsungs pa'i lha mo bdun ni 'khor los sgyur ma drug gi phag mo la chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gnyis su rgyu 'bras kyi dbye bas bdun du song ba'o// des na de gnyis sngags kyang gcig gis 'grub pa yin pas/ go cha drug gi sngags kho na 'dir bzlas bya'o// de yang jo bo nā ro pa'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung de ji lta ba bshad par bya'o// shin tu dben pa'i gnas su yo byad bsags/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste lus gnad bsrangs nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig

sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang bsgrub par bya/ de'i ched du sgom pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmā swabhāwa shuddho ྅haṃ/ rang gi snying gar padma'i steng du gnas pa'i bam̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus pa la thim pas rang lus 'od phung gi rnam pa bam̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug cing gdengs ka che ba gyen du blta ba'i chos 'byung bsnol ma 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi dbus su/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog padma rā ga'i 'od ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar bas rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu ma lus pa gcod par mdzad cing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs khar 'dzin pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ros tshim par mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu do shal byas pa/ thal chen spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer mo brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis srog bral gyi snying ga mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zur drug gi mdun g.yon skor du/ rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ sreg byed ma ser mo/ skrag byed ma ljang khu/ tsaṇḍi ka dud kha/ thams cad 'khor los sgyur ma ji lta ba/ de rnams kyi spyi bor sku rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ/

mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āḥ snying gar thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūm̐/ gtso mo'i lte bar oṃ baṃ/ snying gar haṃ yauṃ/ khar hriṃ moṃ/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ/ lte ba'i dbus su chos 'byung zur drug pa'i lte bar baṃ/ zur la oṃ baṃ haṃ yauṃ hriṃ moṃ hreṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar pheṃ/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ oṃ badzra wā rā hi sa pa ri wā ra/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin pā dyaṃ/ añtsa mā nāṃ/ puṣpe/ dhūpe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai widyā/ shaptas mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar snying ga'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi gzugs bla ma he ru ka'i tshul du bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yon gyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i padma'i snod bzung*/ g.yas ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de lta bu'i lha'i 'khor lo rtse gcig par bsgom/ de nas rlung bzung ste 'khor lo sngags dang bcas pa g.yon du 'khor bar bsam zhing*/ me lce sngags de dag gi sgrar grags pa des rtsa bsros/ de bsros nas khams zhu/ de'i bde ba la sems zin nas mi rtog pa skye'o// de la skyo na/ snying gar pad nyir bam̐ la sngags kyis bskor ba g.yon du 'khor zhing de'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag gi lus ngag yid la zhugs par byin gyis brlabs par bsam la ngag tu oṃ bam̐ sogs/ de nas 'phreng ba dam pa rigs brgyar bsams nas sngags re la de'i lha re bdag la thim par mos la gong gi snying po de brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de nas 'od kyis snod bcud la/ de rang la/ rang yas mas nas zhu snying ga'i sngags de bam̐/

de zla tshes/ thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus nas/ de yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la gzhug ste/ chu las nya ldang ba lta bur langs te/ gtor ma gtong na/ gtor ma 'og tu yaṃ raṃ kaṃ las rlung dang me dang mgo sgyed kyi steng du/ a las thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i kha zla phyed rdo rjes chod pa/ snying ga'i bam̐ gyi 'od kyis rlung bskul bas me 'bar te thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu/ zla phyed rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'og min nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug pa de la bstimaḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ ngag ta ུ pheṃ zhes brjod/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya staṃ dṛṣya hoḥkha kha khā hi/ a li u li i daṃ ba ling ta khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul bas / ljags rdo rje dkar po rtse mo gcig pa sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsams te/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa bcom// khyod ni dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi brjid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol//

ces 'dod don gsol yi ge brgya pa brjod de badzra muḥ zhes brjod nas gtor mgron gshegs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog/ ces bsngo ba bya'o// lha bdun ma dang lhan gcig skyes ma gnyis ka'i tshes bcu la gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gis sindhu ra'i maṇḍal dang po ni bshad pa bzhin la/ gnyis pa la chos 'byung gru gsum pa logs la g.yung drung ris kyis brgyan pa/ de ltar bskyed mchod/ bdud rtsi 'bul bstod/ de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa sogs bya'o// slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa la/ brda mi ston pa tsam gzhan 'dra'o// ces padma dkar pos sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /
